stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Clouds thicken Thanksgiving Day. Rain and freezing rain move in Thanksgiving Night; gusty winds, too.

stories.title: 12-year-old boy struck by car in Anson
stories.summary: A 12-year-old boy was struck by a car in Anson, says a Somerset County deputy. The driver reportedly didn't see him.

stories.title: Firefighters fight wildland fire in Phillips for nearly 24 hours
stories.summary: Crews were able to contain the fire to five acres; officials say they are still working to put out active stump and root fires.

stories.title: CMMC suspends another nurse following union activity, bringing total to 21
stories.summary: The hospital has maintained that disciplinary action is unrelated to union efforts, but the union disagrees. All suspended nurses have advocated for the union.

stories.title: Orrington couple arrested in child sexual exploitation investigation
stories.summary: Corbin Penney faces six counts of sexual exploitation of a minor and an animal cruelty charge related to alleged bestiality.

stories.title: Sunday River ski resort opens for winter season: 'I've been looking forward to it'
stories.summary: With lifts going up at noon, staff says it makes them one of the first in New England to do so.

stories.title: $55K found in Falmouth woods to help residents heat their homes this winter
stories.summary: More than four years after a safe filled with cash was discovered along a Falmouth trail, town councilors have voted to use the money for heating assistance.

stories.title: Person injured in Kittery home fire
stories.summary: The resident of a home in Kittery managed to escape the fire, though suffered minor injuries.

stories.title: MaineHousing awards funding for 88 new affordable apartments in Maine
stories.summary: The funding, awarded through the agency's Rural Affordable Rental Housing Program, will support six projects in Windham, Saco, Springvale, Thomaston and Norway

stories.title: Standard Baking Co. warns customers of data breach
stories.summary: The popular Portland bakery said that customers’ names, credit card numbers, and security codes could be compromised.

stories.title: Maine State Police to increase enforcement throughout Thanksgiving holiday weekend
stories.summary: Beginning Wednesday and continuing through Sunday evening, drivers can expect to see more troopers on major highways and secondary roads.

stories.title: Two Maine men join lawsuit accusing ICE of failing to return seized property
stories.summary: The lawsuit, alleges ICE has a nationwide practice of withholding documents and personal belongings long after people are released from immigration custody.
